candidates.description: This vector activates on words and word fragments containing specific French and English linguistic roots and lexical patterns.
These tokens represent French adverbs of manner, time, degree, and logical connection used to modify verbs, adjectives, or clauses.
This vector represents quantifying determiners and adjectives denoting amount, scale, or significance across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents common French grammatical words, pronouns, and articles.
This feature vector represents proper nouns and thematic terms associated with seasonal events, entertainment, and popular culture.
This vector represents French verb suffixes, specifically ending in -er (such as -igner, -urer, -isser, etc.).
This vector activates for nouns related to monsters, fantasy archetypes, and catastrophic phenomena.
This vector activates for words denoting universality, totality, or inclusive quantification across multiple languages.
This vector activates on various combinations of closing quotation marks and punctuation marks commonly found at the end of sentences or clauses.
This feature activates for proper nouns and roots associated with countries, continents, and nationalities.
